title: The Mole
summary: Avogadro's number, molar mass, and converting between grams, moles and particles.

cbse.chapter: Exploration (2026) Ch 9: Atomic Foundations of Matter

objectives: I can define the mole and the Avogadro constant.
I can convert between mass, moles and number of particles.
I can explain why chemists count particles by weighing.
misconceptions: A mole of every substance has the same mass.
A mole is a unit of mass.
One mole of O₂ contains 6.022 × 10²³ oxygen atoms.
